verdict.rationale: The docs show the Gemini API exposing nearly all AI Studio-facing capabilities (text/image generation, multimodal understanding, structured output, function calling, live voice/video API, batch processing, embeddings, caching, safety settings, thinking/reasoning traces), suggesting broad API/UI parity for an AI-native user building programmatically. However, there is no explicit statement or independent verification that every AI Studio UI feature (e.g. project/billing management, rate-limit dashboards) is API-accessible, and machine-readable API specs (OpenAPI/llms.txt) are absent (404s), undermining full openness for automated discovery. Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API feature parity documentation, a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent confirmation that all AI Studio-only features (e.g. billing/quota management) are API-reachable.
